notes: Sheet lease term is the one-month renewal 04/01-04/30/2024. The tenant stayed through 06/29/2024 and paid May and June rent at 1,800 plus SDRP, RBP and animal fee, so occupancy was month-to-month. Holdover is 60 days after lease end with no open rent. The PM email calls the move-out date 06/30; the sheet says 06/29, which I used. Tenancy began 03/03/2023 (ledger first rent charge); March was a partial month, so the first full month is April 2023, with rent paid 04/13/2023 and the 240.77 late fee paid later. The main uncertainty is the undescribed 1,540 line. Move-out inspection was 07/02/2024 and the tenant says it was cancelled and she was not present. No deposit was held (SDRP).
